# Product assets from Trikonoš

Downloaded from the public product galleries at https://www.trikonos.cz/
for this local site preview at the user's request.

Exact product-page and original image URLs are recorded in
`../products-trikonos.js`, alongside local filenames, names, subtitles and prices.
These are product photographs/mockups, not isolated transparent print designs.
Original files are retained without modification. Prices are a static snapshot,
not a live connection to the shop. Product categories, stock, variant availability
and sales rankings have not been imported or verified. Homepage placement is a
preview selection, not a verified bestseller ranking.

The original 192 generated demo products remain available for category and
pagination testing. The imported products appear first in the all-products view.
Hero print assets in `../designs/` are unchanged.
